textAndButtonBannerData.ctaTitle: Ready to Scale Your Cross-Border Lending Operations?
textAndButtonBannerData.ctaDescription: Decentro enables lenders, fintechs, and credit platforms to run global lending programs with speed, compliance, and control.

data.text: Launch and scale lending products across geographies with localised disbursements, repayment rails, FX handling, and centralised treasury control.
Enable working capital loans, invoice financing, and trade-linked credit with milestone-based disbursements and repayment automation.
Offer cross-border BNPL and short-term credit for global commerce with seamless borrower collections and merchant settlements.
Support diaspora-focused lending products that span multiple countries and currencies, serving borrowers and repayment sources across different regions.
Disburse tuition and living expense loans globally while collecting repayments from borrowers or sponsors across regions.
Power seller and merchant financing for global marketplaces with automated loan disbursements, sales-linked repayments, commission net-offs, and real-time reconciliation.

block1extra.heading:

Loan Automation

block1extra.heading:

Reconciliation

block1extra.heading:

Settlements
